# Psalm 51 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. A psalm of David, regarding the time Nathan the prophet came to him after David had committed adultery with Bathsheba.

**2** Have mercy on me, O God, because of Your unfailing love. Because of Your great compassion, blot out the stain of my sins.

**3** Wash me clean from my guilt. Purify me from my sin.

**4** For I recognize my rebellion; it haunts me day and night.

**5** Against You, and You alone, have I sinned; I have done what is evil in Your sight. You will be proved right in what You say, and Your judgment against me is just.

**6** For I was born a sinner — yes, from the moment my mother conceived me.

**7** But You desire honesty from the womb, teaching me wisdom even there.

**8** Purify me from my sins, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

**9** Oh, give me back my joy again; You have broken me — now let me rejoice.

**10** Don't keep looking at my sins. Remove the stain of my guilt.

**11** Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a loyal spirit within me.

**12** Do not banish me from Your presence, and don't take Your Holy Spirit from me.

**13** Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and make me willing to obey You.

**14** Then I will teach Your ways to rebels, and they will return to You.

**15** Forgive me for shedding blood, O God who saves; then I will joyfully sing of Your forgiveness.

**16** Unseal my lips, Lord, that my mouth may praise You.

**17** You do not desire a sacrifice, or I would offer one. You do not want a burnt offering.

**18** The sacrifice You desire is a broken spirit. You will not reject a broken and repentant heart, O God.

**19** Look with favor on Zion and help her; rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **51:10-12**: Three requests for internal renewal: clean heart, right spirit, Holy Spirit. David doesn't ask for external restoration — he asks to be remade from the inside out.

- **51:16**: 'Open my lips' — the sinner's mouth is sealed by guilt. Only God can unlock praise again. This verse opens every Jewish morning service.

— PNEUMA
